title: MOCHA Open Issues: Remaining Work (Codebase Review)
text: Status: Addressed (Phase 3) TwoPartPaired() (R/two_part.R) combines McNemar zero / non-zero component paired Wilcoxon (paired t-test) non-zero pairs, combined chi-square shape existing TwoPart(). .twoPart_polr() (R/estimate_differential_accessibility.R) fits proportional-odds cumulative-logit model zero / low / high-binned values via MASS::polr, returning Wald χ² group coefficient. wired getDifferentialAccessibleTiles() via new method = pairColumn = arguments (default behaviour unchanged).
